why: Issue #735. Drops the shadowMapSize override, so ?shadowMapSize= parses, reaches the report, and never changes the renderer: a sweep would record a shadow map size the device never drew.
killedBy: applyRenderOverrides (issue #735) changes exactly the field an override names -- population: 4 overrides x 3 presets
startGameWith: dev flags stay off by default applies each single-setting render override on top of the preset, and nothing else (issue #735)
